acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: Collection donated to RAC by Wayne G. Broehl, 1983.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC. Researchers interested in accessing digital media (floppy disks, CDs, DVDs, etc.) or audiovisual material (audio cassettes, VHS, etc.) in this collection must use an access surrogate. The original items may not be accessed because of preservation concerns. To request an access surrogate be made, or if you are unsure if there is an access surrogate, please contact an archivist.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Collection contains the research material assembled by Dartmouth professor Wayne G. Broehl for his historical case study "The International Basic Economy Corporation", published in 1968 as part of the National Planning Association's "United States Business Performance Abroad" series.
The files include: correspondence, printed reports, transripts of interviews, note cards prepared by Broehl and drafts of manuscripts.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Rockefeller Archive Center has title, copyright and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them, and has authority to grant permission to cite and publish material from the collection.
